title: Import workout plan
intro: Take a photo, select images or a PDF. You can review and correct every value before creating a program.
limits: Up to 8 images (8 MB each) or one PDF of 20 pages (15 MB). Total: 20 MB.
offline: Analysis requires a connection. You can create a manual program.
offlineReview: You can edit this review offline. Reconnect to create the program.
wait: Analysis may take up to two minutes. No program is created automatically.
unfinished: You have a plan to review
discardBeforeNew: Resume or discard the review before analyzing another document.
careful: Check every value, especially handwriting, numbers and unclear names. Missing data stays blank.
confirmNotice: Check the imported data before creating the program. Confirmation creates an editable draft.
name: Program name
customNotice: This custom exercise will be created only at final confirmation.
mappingNotice: Your choice does not automatically replace extracted values. Check the prescription.

errors.camera: Camera access denied. Use the gallery or PDF, or allow access in your device settings.
errors.size: The document exceeds the size limits.
errors.count: Choose up to 8 images or one PDF.
errors.format: Unsupported format. Use valid JPEG, PNG, WebP or PDF files.
errors.pdf: The PDF is unreadable, corrupt or password protected.
errors.image: Unreadable image. Try a clearer photo.
errors.noProgram: No workout plan was recognized. Try another document.
errors.output: The plan could not be interpreted correctly. Try a clearer document.
errors.timeout: Analysis took too long. Try again.
errors.rate: You have reached the analysis limit. Try again later.
errors.unavailable: Analysis is currently unavailable. You can create a manual program.
errors.network: Connection unavailable. Check your network and try again.
errors.conflict: This import was already confirmed with different data.
errors.removed: The program created from this import has been removed.
errors.review: Complete valid names, exercises and prescriptions for every day.
errors.storage: Could not save the review on this device. Try again.
errors.generic: The request failed. Your review data is preserved.
errors.customConflict: A custom exercise with this name already exists. Choose it from the catalog or use another name.

unmatched: Unrecognized exercise · choose or create one
privacy: Only after Analyze, documents are sent to the JIMO API and OpenAI for extraction. JIMO does not archive them.
